newsitem.title: GERMANY: West German consumer prices stay subdued in September.
newsitem.headline: West German consumer prices stay subdued in September.

text.p: West German consumer prices remained subdued in September, falling 0.1 percent from the previous month to post annual inflation at a preliminary 1.4 percent, the Federal Statistics Office said.
Both figures were identical with the final August data, the office said. The office will publish final, nationwide data for September in mid-October.
Economist Holger Fahrinkrug at UBS in Frankfurt said the unchanged rates were in line with forecasts, but still surprising given higher oil prices and the softer mark.
Seasonal price declines in food and holiday-related items offset other price gains.
